claims.claim: Automatic and manual gearbox for Toyota Corolla, Carry, Hilux
claims.evidence: No VIN tag, part number, or vehicle-specific marking visible in any photo; witness reports brand/model as unreadable.
No shipping documents, import sticker, or customs marking shown in photos.
No video of engine/shift test, no dyno or bench-test clip; only static photos of the unit on the floor.
Requires audio/video of running unit; not obtainable from still photos.
Transmissions have no odometer; no service record or donor-vehicle mileage document shown.
No close-up of bellhousing bolts/case seam showing original torque paint or absence of tool marks.

risks.proof: Clear photo of part/casting number or VIN tag on the case
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unconfirmed-fitment unit, buyer bears fitment risk

risks.risk: Internal wear, slipping, or burnt clutch plates
risks.proof: Video of unit running/shifting through gears, or endoscope view inside pan

risks.risk: Incomplete electronics (sensors, harness, solenoids missing or damaged)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of every connector and confirmation they are included in sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as sold without working electronics

risks.risk: Torque converter seal failure or internal damage
risks.proof: Leak-down or spin test video of converter
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified converter condition, assume replacement needed

risks.proof: Macro photo of bellhousing bolt heads and seam for tool marks or mismatched paint
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly opened/rebuilt, not original

risks.risk: Hidden corrosion, cracks, or fluid leaks not visible from current angles
risks.proof: Full 360° photos including underside and fluid pan
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition-unknown, worst case cosmetic/structural risk

proof_requests: Photo of the casting/part number plate or stamped ID on the transmission case
Video of the unit running or being spun to check for knocking noise and smooth shifting
Close-up of bellhousing bolts and case seam for tampering evidence
Confirmation photo/list of all included components (harness, sensors, converter, mounts)
Any import/customs paperwork or Belgium origin documentation
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used car transmission/gearbox assembly, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified, unconfirmed-fitment, untested unit pending the listed proofs.
